entries.mechanism: ssi-ecps bridge projection + v1-slice scope, not an Axiom statutory encoding defect. Two verified sub-classes (per-household PE correlation): (a) 1,768 households where Axiom awards but PE has no is_ssi_eligible member — the bridge feeds Axiom generic is_disabled/is_blind rather than PE's SSI-specific disability determination, and the v1 slice omits qualified-alien/institutional criteria; (b) 996 households where PE is eligible but benefit offsets to $0 on income while Axiom awards — the bridge's countable-income assembly diverges from PE ssi_countable_income. Representative: ecps-30 (axiom 17,880 / PE 0), ecps-42 (axiom 11,928 / PE 0), ecps-588 (axiom 1,384.90 / PE 1,504.90).
